name: Pixel Drive Studios
description: Crafting immersive gaming experiences for the ultimate thrill.
story: Pixel Drive Studios, a leading game developer in Mexico, sponsors motorsport to connect with a passionate and competitive audience. Rooted in a culture of pushing boundaries and achieving peak performance, they see a natural synergy between the precision of racing and the immersive experiences they create. They seek a partnership that amplifies their brand and showcases their commitment to innovation.
